answer_1.quote: We generate system response y_t conditioned on the user utterance x_t and tree-structured dialog act A_t ... We employ GPT-2 as the backbone for response generation...
answer_1.outputs: System utterances (responses) in conversational recommendation dialogs

answer_2.quote: We apply BLEU and Distinct-n to measure the generated response on word-level matches and diversity. ... We also adopt knowledge F1-score to measure knowledge exploitation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct point-wise human evaluation. 300 posts are randomly sampled from the test set. For each response generated by each model, we ask 3 worker from AMT to give their ratings according to each metric with a 3-point scale (3/2/1 for good/fair/bad respectively). ... Among the metrics, fluency and coherence focus on the response generation quality, informativeness and effectiveness evaluate ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated response on a 3-point scale for fluency, coherence, informativeness, and effectiveness.
